requirement_snapshot.name: Identity and Access
requirement_snapshot.description: This module defines the “account” and “session” required to access the system. An account is a persistent individual identity storing a username, verified email, and credential status; a session is a record created after successful account sign-in that represents only the current browser login state. Visitors enter the account-access page from “Sign up”, “Sign in”, or “Forgot password” on the home page; signed-in users enter security settings or sign out from the account menu. The account menu is the control in the upper-right corner of the page that displays the current signed-in account, organization list, and sign-out entry. No page, error message, or recovery flow may display a full password. After successful sign-in, the account menu displays the current user, and subsequent organization, repository, issue, and pull-request pages use this session to determine visibility and operation permissions; sign-out, password changes, and recovery must immediately change the session state visible to subsequent requests.
